usedFor: WooCommerce holds store customers and Woodpecker holds outreach prospects, so “New Customer Created” can run “Create/Update Prospect”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in WooCommerce, then “Create/Update Prospect” in Woodpecker
bestTemplate.why: New buyers join your Woodpecker prospect list, and a returning buyer updates the existing prospect.

watchOut: Customers agreed to buy, not to receive outreach, so check consent before “Create/Update Prospect” adds them.
